params.prompt: A straight-on flat front view filling the whole image edge to edge of densely packed convenience store shelf facings in 4 horizontal rows with no shelf edges visible: row 1 colorful snack bags, row 2 cup ramen and instant noodle bowls, row 3 boxed cookies and bread, row 4 soft drink bottles, milk cartons and water bottles.
